description: Steadily is an AI planning tool built by a working parent who had over 100 items on his to-do list, an hour each evening, and a growing sense that the big things kept getting buried under the daily ones. Three things were broken: undated tasks never got done, task size was invisible ("finish my certification" sat next to "drop off a package"), and the list was written for a version of him with eight free hours. Steadily fixes all three. Tell it what you need to finish and it breaks it down into
